listing.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Forbidden Memories / Yu-Gi-Oh! Forbidden Memories Recompiled (Unchiga)
listing.summary: Register an independently permitted existing YFM Re-Decomp Windows copy with your own USA original and external save profile.

steps.title: Complete the title’s supported preparation upstream
steps.instruction: Use only an already completed native copy and components you are independently permitted to use. This route does not recommend fresh bundled-package acquisition: its MIT grant covers the PC layer, explicitly excludes the upstream decompilation and Konami game/data, and the package explicitly bundles European translation texts. Those named component permissions cannot be inherited from MIT. Keep applicable notices and original-game rights separate.

steps.title: Use the matching original and setup procedure
steps.instruction: Provide your own Forbidden Memories USA SLUS-01411 raw MODE2/2352 BIN from a CUE/BIN pair. Select the BIN in the upstream Choose ROM screen, not the CUE. ISO, CHD and other regions are unsupported. No BIOS is needed; the ROM stays at its chosen location. Portcove does not acquire, copy or authenticate it through registration.

steps.title: Add the completed supported game program
steps.instruction: Select the existing package’s memories-pc.exe, its package root as working directory and no arguments. The inspected Windows player is a 32-bit I386 executable; the AMD64 SDK emitter is not the player. Keep the whole matching runtime and do not select FM Editor, a mod builder or another repository’s Forbidden Memories player.

steps.title: Review launch details and manage updates
steps.instruction: Review the selected game executable, working folder and launch arguments, then agree to use them. Choose Play separately when you are ready. You manage setup, game replacement and recovery. Removing the registration leaves external files in place. Before changing versions, close the game and its companion programs and keep the working copy and every data location it uses. Review and select the changed executable before playing again. Portcove does not offer updates, backups, rollback, conversion, data migration or deletion for these external files.

steps.title: Preserve the whole creating copy and effective data
steps.instruction: Preserve Documents/My Games/YFM Re-Decomp and all actual custom roots: settings, controls, memory cards, save states and mods live outside the package. Upstream memory-card import copies into an empty slot and renames the source card .imported; do not use originals as disposable migration input. Emulator save states cannot be imported; native states have build/platform compatibility limits. Keep the creating runtime, original BIN, old saves, native/code mods, caches and backups before upstream updates. Upstream’s update notification is separate from Portcove management.

warnings: Use only a copy and components you are permitted to use. Keep the complete working game, originals, saves, settings, mods, caches, backups and every custom data location before changing versions. Another executable may use those same locations. These instructions do not establish Portcove-managed installation, gameplay or save compatibility.

listing.download_block_reason: Fresh bundled-package acquisition remains held for the explicitly excluded upstream decompilation and Konami game/data scope, including the bundled European translation texts. The MIT PC-layer grant does not settle those named components. Resume only with applicable permissions for the exact components or a reviewed compatible package resolving that scope. A conditional independently permitted existing-copy route does not clear this hold.
